title.narrative: Support to the Capacity of the Office of the Quartet

description.narrative:
The Office of the Quartet (OQ) was established in East Jerusalem in 2002 by the Quartet on the Middle East, consisting of the United Nations, the European Union, the United States and Russia, with a mandate to help mediate Middle East peace negotiations while increasing Palestinian economic and institutional development and empowerment. In the event of a resumption of final status negotiations, the OQ would support Quartet members in their efforts to realize a successful outcome. 
The OQ works to deliver its mandate in five key sectors: water, energy, movement and trade, rule of law and telecommunications. In each of these sectors OQ uses its unique position and expertise to support the development of critical enabling projects, agreements, policy changes or institutional development to deliver greater Palestinian economic development and empowerment. The workstreams are delivered in line with national priorities and strategies and support progress towards the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.
UNOPS provides operational support to the Office of the Quartet.
